children: An address with a 13x leveraged ETH long is currently the largest source of unrealized losses among ETH positions on Hyperliquid, with a loss of $9.493 million. According to Odaily, on-chain analyst Ai Yi said the address opened the position on September 21 and has since reduced it by 8,250 ETH, realizing a loss of $2.277 million. It still holds 40,268.75 ETH, valued at about $97 million, with an average entry price of $2,646.05 and a liquidation price of $2,290.99. The remaining distance to liquidation is $116.51.

title: ETH Address Holding About $97 Million Faces $9.493 Million Loss on 13x Long
